prompt: How must Samba be configured such that it can check CIFS passwords against those found in `/etc/passwd` and `/etc/shadow`?
choices: It is not possible for Samba to use `/etc/passwd` and `/etc/shadow` directly
explanation: Samba uses its own encrypted password database; it is not possible for Samba to check CIFS passwords directly against `/etc/passwd` and `/etc/shadow`.
